name: On-farm Emergency Water Infrastructure Rebate Scheme (AU/NSW)
source: NSW Rural Assistance Authority — Emergency Water Infrastructure Rebate Scheme V2.7 01/20 (provided by the customer 2026-09-07, scanned copy OCR'd). Fund group: regional / industry-specific (grazing).

rules.title: In the GRAZING industry, with a Land and Stock Return
rules.quote: You are a property owner, share-farmer or lessee in the grazing industry (as confirmed by your Land and Stock Return)

rules.title: Eligible business type trading in primary produce
rules.quote: Your business operates as a sole trader, partnership, trust or private company and trades agricultural products

rules.title: Registered as a primary producer with the ATO + has an ABN
rules.quote: Your business is registered with the Australian Taxation Office as a primary producer, and has an Australian Business Number (ABN)

rules.title: Urgent stock-water need (with a water availability statement)
rules.quote: Your property has, or is at risk of, an emergency animal welfare need - as assessed through submission of a completed water availability statement with your application

rules.title: >50% of total income from primary production
rules.quote: As the owner and operator, you earn more than 50% of your gross income from your primary production enterprise under normal seasonal circumstances

rules.title: Off-farm assets ≤ $5,000,000
rules.quote: You do not have gross off farm assets exceeding $5,000,000 excluding funds in a registered superannuation fund

rules.title: 25% rebate on costs, up to $25,000 per farm enterprise
rules.quote: The rebate is 25 per cent of the cost of purchase, delivery and if applicable, the labour cost to engage a person to install water infrastructure for animal welfare needs. The maximum that can be claimed is $25,000 per farm enterprise.

rules.title: Water infrastructure for stock PERMANENTLY on the farm (not agistment)
rules.quote: The water infrastructure is installed for livestock permanently residing on your property and not currently part of an agistment
